title: Nonzero differential detects generic etaleness for smooth curves
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X,Y$ be smooth curves over $k$, meaning separated integral schemes of finite type over $k$ of dimension one [def-pc-curve, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. On an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}B$ of a $k$-scheme $Z$, the sheaf $\Omega_{Z/k}$ is the sheaf associated with the module $\Omega_{B/k}$ of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. For every $k$-morphism $h:X\to Y$, the induced morphism of sheaves $dh:h^*\Omega_{Y/k}\to\Omega_{X/k}$, defined on local functions by $da\mapsto d(h^\sharp a)$, is nonzero if and only if there is a nonempty open subscheme $V\subseteq X$ such that $h|_V:V\to Y$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Here $h^*$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].
